name: Chenley Prime
description: Chenley Prime was a gas giant that contained Shingcu Station, the lair of Boolan. Keeve Trennis, Sskeer, Terec, Ceret, OrbaLin, Lourna Dee, and Tey Sirrek ventured to this station to save a Yacombe girl.
lead_paragraphs: Chenley Prime was a gas giant that contained Shingcu Station, the lair of Boolan. Keeve Trennis, Sskeer, Terec, Ceret, OrbaLin, Lourna Dee, and Tey Sirrek ventured to this station to save a Yacombe girl.
